# Fedora package review

Needs a [Fedora FAS](https://accounts.fedoraproject.org/) account.

1. Create the FAS account (same email as git: `abinashsena@gmail.com`).
2. Sign in to Bugzilla with FAS.
3. Open https://bugzilla.redhat.com/enter_bug.cgi?product=Fedora&component=Package%20Review
4. Paste [`REVIEW-REQUEST.txt`](REVIEW-REQUEST.txt) into the bug.
5. Spec: [`graft.spec`](graft.spec)
6. Reply here with the Bugzilla number.
